entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Consider packaging `dnx` with the .NET Runtime #49796
  • API Diff summary markdown ends with 2 blank lines instead of 1 #49793
  • APIDiff not catching change in parameters to attribute applied to a method parameter #49792
  • Running file-based app using repo-local dotnet install performs restore for .proj file in root of repo #49790
    10.0.1xx
  • [10.0-preview.6] Cannot restore NuGet packages from feedz.io feed on macOS due to NU1301 error #49785
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/9.0.3xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #49782
  • Separating two esproj publish locations #49781
  • [dotnet-sdk-10.0.100-preview.7.25362.103] dotnet tool install command get error: System.TypeLoadException: Could not load type 'System.CommandLine.CommandLineConfiguration' from assembly 'System.CommandLine'. #49786
  • Support latest package version by default when no version is specified in `#:package` directive #49779

Closed

  • .NET 7 Android projects try to restore Microsoft.NETCore.App.Host.linux-* #25388
  • building on build server and assure projects are correctly build / published #32939
  • After installing .NET SDK 9.0.303 creating 8.0 project requires August Servicing (8.0.19) feed. #49778
  • Hide or Move generated *.designer.cs to obj directory #3334
  • ResolvePackageFileConflicts in VS 15.5.3 seem to break previously working build (non-SDK project) #1856
    Discussion
  • Make `dotnet project convert app.cs` interactive by default #49624
    10.0.1xx
